Title:
Underwriter I, Reinsurance
Company:
Everest Reinsurance Company (Ireland), Dac (Zurich Branch)
Job Category:
Underwriting
Job Description:
About Everest:
It’s an exciting time for Everest! As we continue our journey, we see significant opportunity ahead of us to expand our reach, build diversity, and enhance our capabilities in critical markets.

Everest is a leading global insurance and reinsurance provider, operating for nearly 50 years through subsidiaries in the Bermuda, Canada, Europe, Singapore, US, and other territories. Our strengths include extensive product and distribution capabilities, a strong balance sheet, and an innovative culture.

Everest Group, Ltd. (Everest), is a leading global reinsurance and insurance provider, operating for nearly 50 years through subsidiaries in North America, Latin America, the UK & Ireland, Continental Europe and Asia Pacific regions. Throughout our history, Everest has maintained its discipline and focuses on creating long-term value through underwriting excellence and strong risk and capital management. Our strengths include extensive product and distribution capabilities, a strong balance sheet, and an innovative culture. Our most critical asset is our people. We offer dynamic training & professional development to our employees. We also offer generous tuition/continuing education reimbursement programs, mentoring opportunities, flexible work arrangements, and Colleague Resource Groups.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

• Support reinsurance underwriters across Europe on all aspects of assessing, rating, and processing new and renewal business.

• Analyze reinsurance submissions from clients and accurately input relevant data into systems.

• Calculate and book premiums in underwriting systems, issue policy documentation, and manage processing of endorsements.

• Support risk evaluation and pricing through data analysis, modeling, and risk rating tools.

• Assist with maintain and building relationships with clients and brokers, providing exceptional service and ensuring clear communication.

• Support to monitor market trends and developments to align underwriting strategies with emerging risks and opportunities.

• Assist with portfolio analysis and reporting to ensure alignment with organizational risk appetite and performance targets.

• Participate in internal training sessions to maintain up-to-date knowledge of industry practices and regional regulations.

Qualifications, Education & Experience:

• Bachelor's Degree, or equivalent professional qualification.

• Experience in the European or international reinsurance or insurance industry.

• Prior experience of 3-4 years in underwriting (preferably insurance or reinsurance) is strongly preferred, though experience in claims or brokerage is also acceptable.

• Completion of relevant industry certifications (e.g., CPCU, CII, or equivalent) is advantageous.

Knowledge, Skills & Competencies:

• Fluent in English; proficiency in German and/or other European languages is a strong asset.

• Highly detail-oriented, organized, and capable of managing multiple tasks and priorities effectively.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make sound decisions under pressure.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a collaborative and team-oriented mindset.

• Self-motivated and proactive, with a willingness to take initiative and learn from feedback.

• Familiarity with reinsurance principles, regulatory environments, and market dynamics in Europe is a strong plus.

• Comfortable working with technology, including proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

• Ambition to progress within the organization, with a desire to take on increasingly complex underwriting responsibilities.

Our Culture
At Everest, our purpose is to provide the world with protection. We help clients and businesses thrive, fuel global economies, and create sustainable value f

Title:
Senior Actuarial Analyst
Company:
Everest Global Services, Inc.
Job Category:
Analytics
Job Description:
About Everest:
Everest is a global leader in risk management, rooted in a rich, 50+ year heritage of enabling businesses to survive and thrive, and economies to function and flourish. We are underwriters of risk, growth, progress and opportunity. We are a global team focused on disciplined capital allocation and long-term value creation for all stakeholders, who care deeply about our impact on communities and the wider world.
Background
The Actuarial Solutions team is part of Group Actuarial and is responsible for developing, maintaining, and supporting Everest’s global pricing tools, which are key to the success of Everest’s reinsurance business.
This is an opportunity for an actuary with experience in developing reinsurance pricing tools, or a reinsurance pricing actuary with an interest in developing pricing tools, to play an active roll in a worldwide project upgrading Everest’s global reinsurance pricing tool.
The Actuarial Solutions team is also responsible for other technology-related applications, such as reporting, process automation, etc. across pricing, reserving, and other actuarial work, group-wide.
Preferred location : Zurich, London, possibly New York or Warren, NJ.
Key Responsibilities

• Working as part of the Actuarial Solutions team contribute to the development of the new Everest’s Reinsurance pricing tool

• Propose UI designs, actuarial methodologies, platform architecture, etc., consistent with Everest’s reinsurance pricing approaches

• Gather and respond to user feedback from pricing tool users, actuaries and underwriters, on reinsurance pricing.

• Program pricing tool features

• Help ensure the quality and reliability of the new platform through involvement in testing and quality control

• Collaborate with IT and other internal teams on the pricing tool build
In addition, as part of the Solutions team support business-as-usual pricing tool operation

• Support users through troubleshooting, debugging, and issue-resolution for Solutions applications

• Help represent the wishes of international (worldwide excluding US) users in wider discussions

• Help prepare user documentation, guidance materials, and training content.

• Support reinsurance pricing during renewal periods using Everest’s pricing tools.

Knowledge, Skills & Competencies

• Experience in developing reinsurance pricing tools, for example being involved in programming, architecture or UI design etc.

• Strong interest in software development, with experience in at least some of the following: Python, VBA/Excel, SQL, web application development.

• 5 years relevant experience

• Experience working with commercially available platforms for (re)insurance pricing tools an advantage

• Experience and interest in leveraging AI for the efficient development of high-quality applications

• Strong data manipulation skills, ideally using SQL, Python (Pandas/Polars), or R (dplyr).

• Experience in reinsurance pricing.

• Familiarity with modern software development practices (e.g., Git, unit testing, AI).

Qualifications / Experience / Aptitudes

• University degree in science, actuarial science, IT / data-science, mathematics, or a related technical field.

• Qualified actuary or actuarial experience, or actively working toward actuarial qualifications

• Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively with diverse stakeholders.

• Team player with experience working on large or complex software projects.

What if I don’t meet every requirement? At Everest we are dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace. So, if you are excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every element in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. Please let us know if you need any accommodations throughout the applic

Titre: Analyste actuariel principal Société: Everest Global Services, Inc. Catégorie d'emploi : Analyse Description du travail : À propos de Everest : Everest est un leader mondial dans la gestion des risques, enraciné dans un riche patrimoine de plus de 50 ans qui permet aux entreprises de survivre et de prospérer, et aux économies de fonctionner et de prospérer. Nous sommes les garants du risque, de la croissance, du progrès et des opportunités. Nous sommes une équipe mondiale axée sur l'allocation de capital disciplinée et la création de valeur à long terme pour toutes les parties prenantes, qui se soucient profondément de notre impact sur les communautés et le monde entier. Historique L'équipe Actuarial Solutions fait partie du Groupe Actuarial et est chargée de développer, de maintenir et de soutenir les outils de tarification globale Everest, qui sont la clé du succès de l'entreprise de réassurance Everest. C'est l'occasion pour un actuaire ayant l'expérience de développer des outils de tarification de réassurance, ou un actuaire de tarification de réassurance ayant l'intérêt de développer des outils de tarification, de jouer un rôle actif dans un projet mondial de modernisation de l'outil de tarification de réassurance globale Everest. L'équipe de Solutions Actuariennes est également responsable d'autres applications liées à la technologie, telles que les rapports, l'automatisation des processus, etc., en fonction des prix, des réservations et d'autres travaux actuariels, à l'échelle du groupe. Localisation préférée : Zurich, Londres, éventuellement New York ou Warren, NJ. Principales responsabilités
• Travailler dans le cadre de l'équipe de Solutions Actuarial contribue au développement du nouvel outil de tarification de la réassurance Everest.
• Proposer des conceptions d'assurance-chômage, des méthodologies actuarielles, une architecture de plate-forme, etc., conformément aux approches des prix de réassurance de Everest.
• Rassembler les utilisateurs, les actuaires et les souscripteurs et répondre à leurs commentaires sur les prix de réassurance.
• Caractéristiques de l'outil de tarification du programme

• L'aide représente les souhaits des utilisateurs internationaux (à l'exclusion des États-Unis) dans les discussions plus larges
• Aider à préparer la documentation des utilisateurs, le matériel d'orientation et le contenu de formation.
• Soutenir les prix de réassurance pendant les périodes de renouvellement en utilisant les outils de tarification Everest. Connaissances, compétences et compétences
